tables.name: Garments
tables.description: One physical vintage garment per SKU. Editorial master; commerce owns live stock.

fields.name: SKU
fields.description: Unique immutable item code, e.g. NV-000001. Never reuse. Application enforces uniqueness.

fields.name: Title
fields.description: Customer-facing title; do not invent brand, age or species.

fields.name: Slug
fields.description: Unique stable storefront slug.

fields.name: Category
fields.description: Garment construction.

fields.name: Material
fields.description: Verified main material or unknown.

fields.name: Species
fields.description: Only record when supported by label or provenance; unknown is valid.

fields.name: Material evidence
fields.description: Basis for material identification.

fields.name: Brand
fields.description: As seen on the garment label.

fields.name: Era notes
fields.description: Evidence-backed estimate; uncertainty must remain visible.

fields.name: Colour
fields.description: Descriptive colour.

fields.name: Label size
fields.description: Original label text, not a computed modern size.

fields.name: Fit notes
fields.description: Nikki's observations; no guaranteed fit.

fields.name: Condition
fields.description: Condition after inspection.

fields.name: Condition notes
fields.description: Wear, repairs and flaws, including where photographed.

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Approved public description.

fields.name: Draft price minor
fields.description: Proposed price in currency minor units; EUR 12500 means EUR 125.00. Not checkout authority.

fields.name: Currency
fields.description: Provisional MVP currency.

fields.name: Editorial status
fields.description: Ready requests validation; published only after successful synchronization.

fields.name: Sale eligibility
fields.description: Nikki verifies sale eligibility and provenance before publishing.

fields.name: Provenance notes
fields.description: Private acquisition and material evidence; never exposed to storefront.

fields.name: Purchase cost minor
fields.description: Private acquisition cost in currency minor units.

fields.name: Storage location
fields.description: Private physical storage location.

fields.name: Commerce product ID
fields.description: Actual platform product ID after creation; leave blank before.

fields.name: Commerce variant ID
fields.description: One variant for this physical garment.

fields.name: Commerce availability
fields.description: Read-only projection from commerce; never use to initialize stock again.

fields.name: Content revision
fields.description: Incremented by publisher for approved content versions.

fields.name: Last sync at
fields.description: Publisher writes UTC ISO 8601 timestamp.

fields.name: Sync error
fields.description: Redacted failure summary; no secrets or customer data.

tables.name: Measurements
tables.description: One current measurement set per garment. Flat measurements in cm; an omitted measurement is null.

fields.name: Measurement key
fields.description: Unique measurement-set key; one current set per garment.

fields.name: Chest flat cm
fields.description: Straight underarm-to-underarm, closed garment flat, not stretched.

fields.name: Shoulder cm
fields.description: Across back, shoulder seam to shoulder seam; omit for raglan.

fields.name: Back length cm
fields.description: Centre back from collar seam to hem, excluding collar.

fields.name: Sleeve cm
fields.description: Shoulder seam to cuff along outer sleeve.

fields.name: Raglan sleeve cm
fields.description: Centre-back neck point to cuff; use for raglan and explain method.

fields.name: Waist flat cm
fields.description: Flat width at natural waist; record position in notes.

fields.name: Hem flat cm
fields.description: Straight flat width across bottom hem.

fields.name: Tolerance cm
fields.description: Measurement uncertainty, proposed 1.0 cm; confirm per garment.

fields.name: Method version
fields.description: Use flat-v1 when following docs/MEASUREMENTS.md.

fields.name: Measured at
fields.description: ISO 8601 measurement timestamp.

fields.name: Measured by
fields.description: Operator display name; no private contact data.

fields.name: Verification
fields.description: Nikki checks actual measurements before publishing.

fields.name: Notes
fields.description: Closures, thick lining, uneven hem, unavailable dimensions, deviations.

tables.name: Media
tables.description: One image per row; originals private until approved and copied to durable storefront hosting.

fields.name: Media key
fields.description: Unique stable image key.

fields.name: Original
fields.description: Original garment photograph.

fields.name: Role
fields.description: Purpose of photo.

fields.name: Sort order
fields.description: Display order starting at 1; one primary front photo.

fields.name: Alt text
fields.description: Accurate accessible description.

fields.name: Approval
fields.description: Human image approval.

fields.name: Published URL
fields.description: Stable commerce/CDN image URL, never an expiring Airtable attachment URL.

fields.name: Content hash
fields.description: Publisher computes hash to avoid duplicate uploads.

links.relationship: exactly one garment; publisher rejects zero or multiple links
exactly one garment; publisher rejects zero or multiple links
